AIProvider.Name: AI Provider
AIProvider.Hint: Select the AI provider you want to use for translations.

TargetLanguage.Name: Target Language
TargetLanguage.Hint: The language to translate content into (e.g., Russian, German, French).

SourceLanguage.Name: Source Language
SourceLanguage.Hint: The original language of the content (usually English).

BatchSize.Name: Batch Size
BatchSize.Hint: Number of entities to translate in a single AI request. Lower values = more API calls but better error recovery.

MaxPromptLength.Name: Max Prompt Length
MaxPromptLength.Hint: Maximum number of characters to send in a single AI request.

APIKey.Name: API Key (stored in browser)
APIKey.Hint: Your API key for the selected AI provider. This is stored locally in your browser only.

Errors.NoAPIKey: Please configure your API key in module settings.
Errors.NoCompendium: Please select a compendium to translate.
Errors.BabeleNotFound: Babele module not found. Please install and enable it.

Warnings.LargeCompendium: This compendium contains many entities. Translation may take some time and consume API credits.
